events.title: Discover peers and sync over nearby transports
events.body:
## Outcome

Bootstrap and sync nodes on a local network or nearby device link when public routing and Internet access are unavailable.

## Implementation

- Advertise and discover repository-node services through standard local-network service discovery with signed node identity.
- Define one framed resumable peer-stream protocol shared by LAN sockets and platform nearby-link adapters.
- Add LAN-only and nearby-only modes with explicit repository allowlists and no public bootstrap attempt.
- Handle duplicate names, spoofed advertisements, address changes, pairing confirmation, and interrupted transfer.
- Add a disaster bootstrap workflow combining a verified offline bundle, local discovery, and peer sync.

## Acceptance criteria

- LAN-only and nearby-only tests observe no public DNS query or socket.
- An unsigned or identity-mismatched advertisement is never trusted automatically.
- The same interrupted stream resumes across address change without accepting corrupt bytes.
- Two isolated fixture nodes discover, pair, clone, exchange collaboration-only state, and repair from a bundle.
- Disabling discovery removes advertisements and cached addresses within the declared bound.

## Dependencies

Uses resumable and selective sync in #452, route policy in #453, and bundle verification in #441.

## Verification

Run isolated local discovery, duplicate service, spoof, pairing reject, address change, LAN-only leak, nearby-link interruption, collaboration-only sync, corrupt stream, bundle bootstrap, and shutdown-expiry fixtures.
